title: Metamorphic Relations for Steering: Invariants That Should Hold Under Concept Manipulation

original_idea.body: Define a catalogue of metamorphic relations for concept steering and report per-concept/layer violation rates. Inference-only, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: oracle-free validation of steering side effects aids safety, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implement a small catalogue of automated checks; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (violation rates for a defined relation set), several relations add modest scope (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly evaluation-infrastructure work, reusable template, open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Metamorphic-testing framework for steering invariants appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Metamorphic relations as a steering validation framework appears underexplored.
